entries.name: Kickoff & Administration
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Client & Brief
entries.description: PIF, CDB, identitas dan kontak klien, tujuan, kebutuhan, preferensi dan prioritas.

entries.name: Site Survey
entries.description: Pengukuran, kondisi eksisting, akses, utilitas, foto dan temuan lapangan.

entries.name: Feasibility & Scope
entries.description: Kelayakan awal, alternatif, asumsi, batasan, scope dan pengecualian.

entries.name: Proposal & Fee
entries.description: Layanan, deliverable, fee, termin dan ketentuan revisi.

entries.name: Contract & Appointment
entries.description: Kontrak, penunjukan, kewajiban para pihak dan perubahan kesepakatan.

entries.name: Project Setup
entries.description: Identitas, klasifikasi, luas awal, target, penomoran dan pengelolaan data.

entries.name: Team Mobilization
entries.description: Organisasi, PIC, tanggung jawab, akses dan jalur koordinasi.

entries.name: Kickoff Meeting & Action Plan
entries.description: Agenda, notulen, keputusan, kebutuhan data dan tindakan awal.

entries.name: Kickoff Final & Approval
entries.description: Kompilasi dasar proyek yang disepakati.

entries.name: Planning & Design
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Design Criteria
entries.description: Brief acuan, kriteria fungsi/kinerja, prinsip desain dan batasan.

entries.name: Space Planning
entries.description: Program ruang, luas, kapasitas, hubungan ruang, zoning, sirkulasi dan layout.

entries.name: Concept Design
entries.description: Konsep arsitektur/interior/landscape, massa dan respons tapak.

entries.name: Moodboard & Materials
entries.description: Referensi, warna, tekstur, kandidat material, sampel dan pilihan.

entries.name: 3D Model
entries.description: Model pengembangan, alternatif, koordinasi dan versi model.

entries.name: Design Presentation
entries.description: Render, perspektif, diagram, narasi dan paket presentasi.

entries.name: Design Development
entries.description: Desain terpilih, denah/tampak/potongan desain dan dimensi utama.

entries.name: Design Review & Resolution
entries.description: Komentar, evaluasi opsi, respons, perubahan dan keputusan.

entries.name: Design Final & Approval
entries.description: Paket desain terpilih beserta batas persetujuannya.

entries.name: Engineering
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Engineering Basis & Input Data
entries.description: Data tapak/tanah, parameter, asumsi, kriteria dan referensi teknis.

entries.name: Structural Engineering
entries.description: Beban, fondasi, elemen struktur, model dan laporan perhitungan.

entries.name: Mechanical Engineering
entries.description: Pendinginan, ventilasi, kapasitas peralatan dan ruang mekanikal.

entries.name: Electrical Engineering
entries.description: Beban listrik, distribusi, kabel, penerangan, grounding dan cadangan.

entries.name: Plumbing & Drainage Engineering
entries.description: Air bersih, tangki, pompa, pipa, limbah dan drainase.

entries.name: Fire Protection & Life Safety
entries.description: Kriteria keselamatan, sistem kebakaran, kapasitas dan koordinasi.

entries.name: Specialist Systems & Integration
entries.description: ELV, data/security, lift dan sistem spesialis sesuai scope.

entries.name: Engineering Review & Verification
entries.description: Pemeriksaan perhitungan, koordinasi dan penyelesaian temuan.

entries.name: Engineering Final & Approval
entries.description: Dasar teknis dan hasil engineering yang diperiksa.

entries.name: Permits
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Permit Requirements & Strategy
entries.description: Daftar izin, instansi, tahapan, target dan PIC.

entries.name: Land & Legal Documents
entries.description: Kepemilikan/penguasaan, kuasa, identitas dan legal pendukung.

entries.name: Planning & Zoning Review
entries.description: Kesesuaian lokasi/fungsi, batasan tapak dan ketentuan pengembangan.

entries.name: Environmental & Supporting Studies
entries.description: Kajian lingkungan dan studi pendukung sesuai proyek.

entries.name: Permit Submission Package
entries.description: Form, gambar, laporan, lampiran dan kelengkapan pengajuan.

entries.name: Authority Review & Responses
entries.description: Komentar instansi, perbaikan, respons dan pengajuan ulang.

entries.name: Issued Permits & Conditions
entries.description: Izin terbit, nomor, tanggal, masa berlaku dan syarat.

entries.name: Permit Monitoring & Closeout
entries.description: Pemenuhan persyaratan, pembaruan dan penutupan kewajiban.

entries.name: Permit Status & Clearance
entries.description: Status izin, cakupan dan batas pelaksanaan; bukan pengganti izin instansi.

entries.name: Technical Documentation
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Architectural Working Drawings
entries.description: Denah, tampak, potongan, detail dan schedule arsitektur.

entries.name: Structural Working Drawings
entries.description: Fondasi, struktur, penulangan, sambungan dan detail berdasar perhitungan.

entries.name: MEP Working Drawings
entries.description: Gambar mekanikal, elektrikal, plumbing, kebakaran dan sistem terkait.

entries.name: Interior & Landscape Working Drawings
entries.description: Detail interior, furniture, planting, hardscape dan pekerjaan terkait.

entries.name: Technical Specifications
entries.description: Material, mutu, metode, kinerja, pemasangan dan pengujian.

entries.name: BOQ & Quantity Documentation
entries.description: WBS acuan, volume, measurement sheet dan BOQ.

entries.name: Cost Estimate & Baseline Schedule
entries.description: RAB, dasar harga, asumsi, jadwal dan bobot acuan.

entries.name: Technical Package Review & Issue Control
entries.description: Koordinasi, kelengkapan, revisi, transmittal dan tujuan terbit.

entries.name: Technical Package Final & Approval
entries.description: Paket teknis dengan tujuan penggunaan yang disetujui.

entries.name: Procurement
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Procurement Plan & Packages
entries.description: Paket pengadaan, strategi, kebutuhan dan target pesan/kirim.

entries.name: Vendor & Contractor Qualification
entries.description: Kandidat, profil, kemampuan, pengalaman dan kelayakan.

entries.name: RFQ & Tender Documents
entries.description: Undangan, scope, spesifikasi, BOQ dan instruksi penawaran.

entries.name: Quotations & Bid Clarifications
entries.description: Penawaran, klarifikasi, pengecualian dan konfirmasi.

entries.name: Technical & Commercial Evaluation
entries.description: Evaluasi teknis, harga, syarat, risiko dan rekomendasi.

entries.name: Material & Equipment Selection
entries.description: Produk, sampel, spesifikasi vendor, alternatif dan pilihan.

entries.name: Award, Purchase Orders & Subcontracts
entries.description: Negosiasi, penunjukan, PO dan subkontrak.

entries.name: Delivery & Procurement Closeout
entries.description: Pengiriman, penerimaan pesanan, kekurangan, klaim dan closeout.

entries.name: Procurement Final & Approval
entries.description: Dasar pemilihan dan persetujuan per paket pengadaan.

entries.name: Construction
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Site Mobilization & Logistics
entries.description: Kesiapan lapangan, fasilitas sementara, akses, penyimpanan dan logistik.

entries.name: Method Statements & Work Planning
entries.description: Metode, urutan, tenaga/peralatan dan rencana kerja.

entries.name: Shop Drawings & Technical Submittals
entries.description: Gambar kontraktor/vendor, detail fabrikasi dan submittal.

entries.name: Site Instructions & RFIs
entries.description: Instruksi, pertanyaan teknis, respons, keputusan dan batas pelaksanaan.

entries.name: Work Execution Records
entries.description: Catatan harian, lokasi, tenaga/peralatan, foto dan aktivitas.

entries.name: Installed Quantities & Work Measurement
entries.description: Opname, hasil terpasang, lokasi, volume dan bukti pengukuran.

entries.name: Field Changes & Variation Implementation
entries.description: Pelaksanaan perubahan yang diotorisasi dan bukti pekerjaan.

entries.name: Construction Completion & Readiness
entries.description: Pekerjaan tersisa, kesiapan inspeksi dan serah terima.

entries.name: Construction Completion & Approval
entries.description: Penyelesaian pelaksanaan per area/paket; bukan pengganti penerimaan mutu atau serah terima.

entries.name: Quality Inspection
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Quality Plan & Acceptance Criteria
entries.description: Rencana mutu, inspection/test plan, toleransi dan checkpoint.

entries.name: Material Receiving Inspection
entries.description: Produk datang, kondisi, jumlah, kesesuaian dan sertifikat.

entries.name: Workmanship & Installation Inspection
entries.description: Mutu pemasangan, dimensi, detail, lokasi dan hasil inspeksi.

entries.name: Testing & Commissioning
entries.description: Rencana/hasil pengujian, alat ukur, parameter dan commissioning.

entries.name: Nonconformance & Corrective Actions
entries.description: Ketidaksesuaian, penyebab, koreksi, PIC dan target.

entries.name: Punch List & Defect Rectification
entries.description: Cacat/kekurangan, lokasi, foto, perbaikan dan verifikasi ulang.

entries.name: Joint & Witness Inspections
entries.description: Pemeriksaan bersama klien, konsultan, vendor dan pihak terkait.

entries.name: Quality Dossier & Closeout
entries.description: Sertifikat, hasil uji, bukti koreksi dan kelengkapan rekaman mutu.

entries.name: Quality Final & Acceptance
entries.description: Kesimpulan kesesuaian dan penerimaan per paket/sistem.

entries.name: Tracking & Control
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Baseline & Control Setup
entries.description: WBS, RAB, jadwal, bobot, periode dan aturan pengukuran.

entries.name: Physical Progress Tracking
entries.description: Aktual per item/area, volume selesai, bobot dan bukti realisasi.

entries.name: Schedule Monitoring & Forecast
entries.description: Rencana/aktual, keterlambatan, milestone dan forecast selesai.

entries.name: Cost Monitoring & Forecast
entries.description: Anggaran, komitmen, aktual, perubahan dan forecast akhir.

entries.name: Payment & Commercial Tracking
entries.description: Pengajuan, verifikasi, invoice, pembayaran dan saldo.

entries.name: Risk, Issue & Change Control
entries.description: Risiko, masalah, perubahan, dampak, keputusan dan tindak lanjut.

entries.name: Coordination & Action Tracking
entries.description: Rapat, action register, PIC, target, eskalasi dan keputusan.

entries.name: Periodic Reporting & Recovery Plan
entries.description: Laporan berkala, penyimpangan, recovery dan forecast.

entries.name: Project Control Review & Approval
entries.description: Paket laporan per periode; revisi dibedakan dari periode baru.

entries.name: Handover
entries.description: Stage group

entries.name: Handover Plan & Requirements
entries.description: Scope, tahapan, penerima, target dan persyaratan.

entries.name: As-Built Drawings & Models
entries.description: Kondisi terpasang, pemeriksaan kesesuaian dan revisi.

entries.name: Operation & Maintenance Manuals
entries.description: Operasi, perawatan, prosedur, troubleshooting dan jadwal.

entries.name: Asset, Warranty & Spare Parts
entries.description: Aset, nomor seri, garansi, kontak vendor, spare parts dan perlengkapan.

entries.name: Training & Operational Demonstration
entries.description: Materi, peserta, pelatihan, demonstrasi dan kesiapan operator.

entries.name: Final Account & Commercial Closeout
entries.description: Nilai akhir, perubahan, pembayaran, retensi dan kewajiban.

entries.name: Handover Inspection & Acceptance Records
entries.description: Inspeksi, berita acara, kekurangan dan batas penerimaan.

entries.name: Defects Liability & Post-Handover Follow-up
entries.description: Masa pemeliharaan, cacat, tindak lanjut, verifikasi dan penutupan.

entries.name: Handover Final & Acceptance
entries.description: Paket serah terima sebagian/awal/akhir dengan kewajiban tersisa.
